description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for the fourth-order 2-D rule(s) driven by problems/heat_2d_y_dirichlet_o4.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). The manufactured solution is exact for the continuous PDE (derivation in the problem file); the steady linear/ramp component is discretely exact for the fourth-order operator (all closure weight-sums are zero), so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial fourth-order truncation from the smooth decaying mode. expected_order 4.0; the honestly observed order is pinned by golden/errors.json.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
